Author Publishing Guidelines

What NovelHaven expects from every original author submission.

Who can publish?

You must have the legal right to publish all submitted words and characters. Do not upload pirated books, unauthorized translations, copied chapters, or AI-generated spam. You remain responsible for the work you submit.

Copyright and license

You keep ownership of your original manuscript. By submitting, you grant NovelHaven a non-exclusive, worldwide, royalty-free license to store, reproduce and display the submitted work as needed to operate the reading service. You may request a takedown at novelhaven15@gmail.com. Taking a story down from the site does not necessarily remove previously shared copies or backups immediately.

Quality and content

Each submitted novel needs a meaningful synopsis and at least one substantial chapter. Do not include explicit sexual content, sexual content involving minors, hateful content, violent extremism, personal-information disclosures, malicious links, scams, copyright violations, or deceptive spam.

Editorial approval

All new manuscripts require manual review before publication. NovelHaven may reject, request revisions, or remove a story when needed for rights, quality, safety or advertising policy compliance. Review does not certify that an author owns the work.

After publication

Approved novels can be taken offline after reports of copyright infringement, unsafe content, or policy problems. Authors keep access to their private manuscripts and may request clarification or removal at novelhaven15@gmail.com.

Advertising

Drafts and submitted manuscripts are never ad placements. Initially, approved original-story pages are also ad-free while the service and content quality are reviewed. Publishing does not guarantee advertising eligibility or compensation.

Personal data

Your Google account identifier, author pen name, submitted stories and review status are stored using Firebase/Firestore. Approved novel details and chapters are publicly readable. See Privacy Policy.
